title: Small-Batch Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
description: A small pan of soft oatmeal cookies with raisins or chocolate chips.

steps.text: Heat oven to 350°F and line a baking sheet.
Beat 4 tablespoons softened butter with 1/4 cup brown sugar and 2 tablespoons granulated sugar. Mix in 1 egg yolk and 1/2 teaspoon vanilla.
Stir in 1/3 cup flour, 1/2 cup oats, 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon, and 1/8 teaspoon baking soda. Fold in 1/4 cup raisins or chocolate chips.
Divide into 6 mounds and bake 10–12 minutes, until the edges are set but centers still look soft.

title: Peanut Butter Mug Cake
description: A warm single-serving peanut butter cake mixed and cooked right in a mug.

steps.text: In a 12-oz microwave-safe mug, stir together 3 tablespoons flour, 2 tablespoons brown sugar, and 1/4 teaspoon baking powder.
Stir in 3 tablespoons milk, 2 tablespoons peanut butter, and 1/4 teaspoon vanilla until smooth.
Microwave 50–70 seconds, stopping when the top looks set but still soft. Let stand 1 minute before eating.

title: Baked Cinnamon Banana Boats
description: Warm bananas with cinnamon and a little brown sugar, baked until soft and caramel-like.

steps.text: Heat oven to 400°F. Split 2 bananas lengthwise through the peel without cutting all the way through the bottom peel.
Sprinkle each banana with 1 teaspoon brown sugar and a pinch of the 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon. Add optional chocolate chips or nuts.
Place in a small baking dish and bake 10–12 minutes, until very soft and syrupy.

title: Garlic Butter Noodles
description: A fast pantry bowl of tender noodles with butter, garlic, and Parmesan.
substitutions: Skip Parmesan and add a splash of soy sauce for a different pantry version.

steps.text: Boil the noodles in salted water until tender; reserve 1/4 cup pasta water and drain.
Melt 3 tablespoons butter in a skillet over medium-low heat. Add 2 minced garlic cloves and cook about 30 seconds without browning.
Add the drained noodles, 1/4 cup Parmesan, black pepper, and a splash of pasta water. Toss until glossy and serve.
